text: Fuck a good morning text. Does he invest for you? Flowers are great, but does he put money into my 401k? But I'm sorry, I'm 25. I need some real investment. I need a man who's going to be buying me crypto. I need a man that's going to be putting money towards my future, towards my savings account. Is he paying for me to take classes somewhere? Is he paying for my master's? My dad set the standard for this. He stays investing for me and managing my investment account. Like a guy taking me on vacation means nothing for me. First of all, he benefits from that too. So it's not even just for me, but also that does nothing for my future. Look, I've seen entitlement before, but this one is a masterpiece. According to her, romance is not flowers, not effort, not consistency. It's a man paying for her master's degree, buying her crypto, depositing into her savings account, managing her retirement funds, all at 25. Apparently, showing love now means acting like her personal financial advisor with benefits. And the wildest part, she uses her dad as the standard. My dad invest for me? Yes, because he's your father. Parents invest in their children. Grown partners are supposed to invest with each other. Not one way into someone else's portfolio while getting nothing in return. This mindset is part of the reason modern dating is collapsing. Some people don't want partnership. They want sponsorship. They think a man's affection should be measured in assets, transfers, retirement contributions, and tuition payments. Meanwhile, what exactly is she offering in return? Because I didn't hear one word about effort, support, loyalty, or building a future together. Ladies, please stop turning relationships into financial products. And guys, if a woman starts talking like this, run! Not walk, run! Because you won't be her partner. You'll be her walking ATM. A healthy relationship is two adults building a future together. Not one adult funding the other like a venture capital project. Men, choose women who want to build with you, not spend through you.
